newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SA PINTO TO APPEAL AGAINST BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SA PINTO TO APPEAL AGAINST BAN.

text.p: Portuguese striker Ricardo Sa Pinto will appeal to the world soccer's governing body FIFA against a 12-month ban, the player's lawyers said on Monday.
Sa Pinto, who plays for Spanish club Real Sociedad, was banned last month for assaulting national team coach Artur Jorge in March after he was left out of the Portuguese squad.
The player's appeal will be backed by Real Sociedad president Luis Uranga and team coach Bernard Krauss. They said they hoped any sanction would be for a 'reasonable period'.
Sa Pinto signed for Real Sociedad on July 2 for 550 million pesetas ($3.6 million) despite the ban.
